This is not just a fantasy musical.
It is a carefully packaged inversion of good and evil.
The story flips the biblical narrative on its head:
• Evil is reframed as misunderstood
• Rebellion is recast as empowerment
• God-like authority is portrayed as tyrannical
• Witchcraft is softened, normalized, and celebrated
• Obedience is mocked as “blind rule-following”
• Defiance is glorified as freedom
In Wicked, the “wicked” character becomes the hero, while the Wizard—who clearly parallels God’s authority, law, and order—is portrayed as corrupt, weak, and oppressive. The narrative subtly trains viewers to sympathize with rebellion, cheer for resistance, and question whether rules, commandments, and moral boundaries are unjust.
This is propaganda wrapped in pink and green.
But here’s what most people are missing:
The movie is based on a novel that is NOT child-friendly.
The original Wicked book contains graphic adult material, including:
• Incest
• Orgies
• Beastiality
• Sexual violence
• Cannibalism
• Explicit sexual acts
Even adult readers describe the book as disturbing and shocking.
And yet—
The book has now been re-released in major retail chains like Walmart, repackaged with the PG-rated movie cover, making it appear safe, whimsical, and appropriate for kids.
That is not an accident.
Children who love the movie will naturally want the book. Parents will see the PG branding and assume it’s harmless—without realizing what’s actually inside.
This is how deception works in modern media:
Not by being obvious.
But by being palatable.
Scripture is clear:
• Witchcraft is not neutral entertainment
• Rebellion is equated with witchcraft (1 Samuel 15:23)
• Darkness and light do not mix (2 Corinthians 6:14)
• We are warned not only against practicing evil—but taking pleasure in it
We are not called to panic.
But we are called to discern.
Parents—please research before you assume.
Christians—please stop equating popularity with innocence.
And everyone—please understand that Satan no longer hides. He packages.
If this opened your eyes, please share.
Someone else needs to see this before it’s too late.
